images.title: The One Who Stayed
images.prompt: Stylised cinematic 3D animated film still: a fantasy world inside a living body shown as cave cathedrals lit from within, soft translucent tissue with subsurface scattering, dry chalky ivory for bone, light from inside the walls. At the left, a tall slender old lamp-keeper seen from the side and slightly behind, a simplified animated character with smooth pale mineral blue skin, in a long pale woven robe to the floor. His head is small and naturally proportioned, a smooth rounded hairless head on a normal slim neck, bowed and turned away so no face shows, the back of the head edged with gold lamplight. One arm of natural length, with an elbow and a large gentle hand, is raised and cups a small closed wall lamp, a glowing glass bead of warm light, just above head height, dimming it. The lamps further along are already low and small. Far across the hall a row of small rounded alcoves glow faintly pale blue. On a low pale shelf beside him rests a carved ivory game board with round hollows and a few counters left in them, unfinished. Deep mineral blue, soft and dim, one point of steady gold. The lower quarter is empty dark cave floor. Quiet, patient, lonely, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

One smooth rounded sculpted hand with short rounded fingertips, deep red with a band of mineral blue at the wrist, rests palm down on the ledge, flat, still and relaxed, forearm entering from the lower left edge, the skin unmarked and smooth. Far off at the upper right, tiny and out of focus, a warm orange point of a small raft drifts away. Cool pale light on the fingers. The lower quarter is smooth dark shadow.
